original_content_full:
Paper accepted for Int. Workshop on Recommendation Systems for Software Engineering

A paper about "Extending Recommendation Systems with Software Maps" authored by Jonas Trümper and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted for the 3rd International ICSE Workshop on Recommendation Systems for Software (RSSE) 2012. The conference will take place in Zurich, Switzerland, on June 4th, 2012.
